items.description: Admin user cannot access 'Produksi (BOM & WO)' menu from sidebar. Menu item not visible in GUDANG group despite being configured for admin role in navStructure.js. Warehouse role CAN access it successfully.
items.suggested_fix: 1. Check navigationConfig.js and navStructure.js for admin role configuration. 2. Verify static bundle includes latest navigation code. 3. Check if there's a conditional rendering issue for admin role. 4. Consider if this is related to entity switching or permission loading timing.
items.verification: Main agent reported manual verification showed it working. This may be intermittent or environment-specific. Recommend: 1. Clear browser cache and rebuild frontend bundle. 2. Check browser console for errors. 3. Verify navigation rendering logic for admin role.
